notes: «حج علي وعثمان» is the story Sa'id tells: Ali and Uthman are in the scene, not links. The last link is the one whose account the saying is.

fixes.reason: RWY adds علي and وعثمان as transmitters after سعيد بن المسيب, but the text has Sa'id narrating the events of Hajj, with Ali and Uthman as their actors.

evidence.quote: قال سمعت سعيد بن المسيب، يقول حج علي وعثمان
